notes: ACCESS: www.interiordefine.com reached directly with curl_cffi (chrome124) - HTTP 200 throughout, no proxy, no r.jina.ai needed. robots.txt names no Anthropic / Claude / ClaudeBot agent; it sets Crawl-delay: 10 for User-agent: * (honoured - all requests serialised with >=1s gaps and only ~20 requests total) and disallows /catalogsearch/, /checkout/, /customer/, /catalog/product/view/ etc., none of which were used. TREE SOURCE: the site's own Magento GraphQL endpoint POST /graphql, which is the exact data source the PLP and mega-menu render from. IMPORTANT CORRECTION to the Furniture-pass method: categoryList(filters:{parent_id:{eq:X}}) silently truncates at 20 items per parent (root id 2 returned only 20), so the BFS was redone with categories(filters:{parent_id:{eq:X}},pageSize:300){total_count items{...}} and total_count was compared to len(items) at every node to prove no truncation (no TRUNC warning fired anywhere). Root id 2 -> total_count 76. Full breadth-first walk to exhaustion terminated at depth 3 with 154 distinct categories covering the entire catalogue: the seven real departments are Living (589), Bedroom (24), Dining (104), Office (36), Rugs (94), Lighting (16), Decor (122), plus Outdoor (14), Warehouse Sale, In Stock, Best Sellers and ~60 named collection / editorial buckets. (2) That node is EMPTY: both its categoryList product_count and an independent products(filter:{category_id:{eq:\"355\"}},pageSize:1).total_count return 0, so there is no listing and no leaf to record; its parent Decor (id 289) returns 136 and consists of Artwork / Pillows / Throws, i.e. general decor, not bathroom. (3) The real XML sitemap at https://www.interiordefine.com/media/sitemap/sitemap.xml (the one robots.txt points to; the /sitemap/sitemap.xml alias serves the SPA shell) contains 2,927 URLs and the same regex sweep returns exactly two: the empty /decor/mirrors category and one PDP, /redmond-floor-mirror-metal-black - a decorative leaning floor mirror, not a bathroom mirror. No bath, vanity, sanitaryware, basin, toilet, shower, tap, faucet or bathroom-storage URL exists on the domain. CONCLUSION: Interior Define is a made-to-order upholstery / case-goods brand with no bathroom department, no bath vanities, no bathroom mirrors and no bath storage. Its only mirror category is empty.
